name: SealQA
intro: SealQA是一个新的挑战性基准测试，旨在评估搜索增强型语言模型在事实查询问题上的推理能力。该基准测试的特点是网络搜索结果可能存在冲突、噪音或无用信息。它包含Seal-0、Seal-Hard和LongSeal三种类型，分别侧重于事实准确性、推理能力以及长上下文、多文档推理。
build_method: 6名NLP研究者人工构建, 多轮失败测试, 至少两名研究生复审与专家批准
eval_feature: 检索增强, 困难负例, 长上下文多文档, 自动判分
build_method_en: Six NLP researchers, repeated model-failure testing, review by at least two graduate researchers, and expert approval
eval_feature_en: Search augmentation, hard negatives, long-context multi-document reasoning, and automatic grading
intro_en: SealQA evaluates search-augmented reasoning on factual questions whose web evidence may be conflicting, noisy, or unhelpful. Its reviewed question pool yields Seal-0, Seal-Hard, and the multi-document LongSeal setting.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SealQA arXiv:2506.01062 Sections 2-4 and Appendices A-C; official vtllms/sealqa dataset. SealQA is created over eight months by six NLP researchers, who spend more than one hour per question on average. They write single-answer questions in five categories: advanced reasoning, disambiguation, temporal tracking, cross-lingual search, and false-premise detection. Each item includes supporting web pages, an explanation, freshness and expected-search-result labels, and is repeatedly refined until frontier models fail. At least two graduate reviewers check URLs, answer correctness, and clarity before expert approval; volatile items receive effective years and review dates. Seal-0 contains 111 questions with repeated zero-percent performance from tested frontier non-reasoning systems with browsing; Seal-Hard expands to 254. LongSeal pairs each of those 254 questions with one gold source and 50 hard negatives. Evaluation uses tool-enabled or search-injected settings, randomizes the gold position among 12, 20, or 30 documents for LongSeal, and uses GPT-4o-mini to label answers correct, incorrect, or not attempted before reporting accuracy and category breakdowns.
